## Scope

- Issue:
- Source/upstream contract affected:
- TF semantics affected:
- Agora/app contract affected:

## Research / plan

- [ ] Research is grounded in current source/code/docs.
- [ ] Plan/design is recorded before semantic implementation.
- [ ] Any BHSA precedent is semantically justified rather than copied cosmetically.

## TDD / validation

- [ ] RED-first regression/contract test exists.
- [ ] Relevant unit/integration tests pass.
- [ ] Full-corpus validation was run when required.
- [ ] Generated TF was loaded with supported Text-Fabric when required.
- [ ] No source/generated corpus data was committed.
- [ ] No semantic JSON/XML/list blob or semantic sidecar was introduced.

## Review

- Exact head SHA:
- [ ] Logically independent adversarial review covers this exact head.
- [ ] Review is grounded in real source/generated data where applicable.
- [ ] Behavior-changing review fixes were re-tested and re-reviewed.
